高级.head: mormolyke
高级.example: And remember that Lamia is described by Philostratus as a mormolyke, or werewolf.

高级.head: lycanthropy
高级.example: Horrified by what her sister has become, Brigitte develops a cure for Ginger’s lycanthropy.

高级.head: succubus
高级.example: Perplexed by Jennifer’s sudden monsterification, Needy does some research and finds out in the occult section of the library that Jennifer is, technically, a succubus.

高级.head: matrilinear
高级.example: On the one hand, Monstrous Bitches in Raw come by their monstrosity through a matrilinear process of inheritance; monstrosity is understood to be innate, baked into a woman’s nature, her essential character as it descends to her from her mother.

高级.head: autosomal-dominant
高级.example: This is a film in which—to use modern terminology—cannibalism is a sex-linked, autosomal-dominant trait in female children, which only has to be triggered by a mild environmental injury in order to awaken the pathological process.

高级.head: Erichtho
高级.example: Like Lamashtu, Erichtho, Canidia, lamiae, and vampiresses, she is now a Monstrous Bitch who eats human flesh.

高级.head: Bacchanalian
高级.example: So there’s something more than a little Bacchanalian at work in this dance.

高级.head: indomitability
高级.example: That dynamic of celebrating the indomitability of the Monstrous Bitch will get turned way, way up as the 2000s wend their way forward.

高级.head: Alecto
高级.example: Her order heralds a return to the Bacchanal, to a world ruled by Alecto and Erichtho, rather than by patriarchs and matriarchs who want only to control young women.

进阶.head: patriarchal
进阶.example: Patriarchal Katherine is murdered by her own daughter.

进阶.head: monstrosity
进阶.example: Her monstrosity includes all the usual elements: First, she is a sexual predator.

进阶.head: sapphic
进阶.example: Of course, Justine and her sister and mother aren’t just riffing on Dorothy and Debbie; they are also like Lilith and the liliths, Lamia and the lamiae, or any number of the sexy sapphic vampires out there—though their “offspring” are born of a bite, rather than through childbirth.

进阶.head: forcible
进阶.example: But it is similar in that it is a forcible introduction of flesh into an orifice of her body that she doesn’t want to receive that flesh.

进阶.head: allegory
进阶.example: The possession ritual is a barely veiled allegory for gang rape; the result of this rape-possession, for Jennifer, is that she is turned into a demonically sexy vampiress cannibal wolf-woman.

进阶.head: dehumanizing
进阶.example: Mother Markos sees in Susie only a vessel for her own rebirth; in both cases, there is a poisonous, dehumanizing maternal controllingness at work.

进阶.head: seductive
进阶.example: Thomasin is, in her mother’s eyes, a lamia, a seductive, spellcasting witch who murders babies and children for their blood.

进阶.head: monstrous contagion
进阶.example: Needy’s Monstrous Bitch origin isn’t about rape or demonic possession—it’s about monstrous contagion between women.

进阶.head: possession ritual
进阶.example: The possession ritual is a barely veiled allegory for gang rape; the result of this rape-possession, for Jennifer, is that she is turned into a demonically sexy vampiress cannibal wolf-woman.

基础.head: vampire
基础.example: That means that Needy’s form of Monstrous Bitchery—unlike Jennifer’s—is in the Bacchae/vampire/werewolf tradition, rather than the possession tradition.

基础.head: cannibal
基础.example: The most concerning symptom, it turns out, is that she has become an obligate cannibal.

基础.head: monster
基础.example: So this film seems to participate in the punish-the-monsters trajectory we’ve seen in cinema since the 1930s.

基础.head: sisters
基础.example: Ginger Snaps centers on two sisters—Ginger and Brigitte—who are “goth girls” obsessed with death, the macabre, and the occult.

基础.head: girl
基础.example: The twins are not made into witches—not even the little girl, Mercy.

基础.head: bite
基础.example: Justine is going to bite back hard.

基础.head: witch
基础.example: Maybe it’s not so bad to be a witch.

基础.head: blood
基础.example: So clad, they look like stylized dead people, streaked with blood and mortally wan underneath.
